evaluation_launch_correction: The first aggregate launch omitted env.sh, so the pinned sqlite3 reference and the unit fixture path were unavailable. Its failed launch receipts/logs are retained separately; it is not an SQL compatibility measurement. The corrected final run sources the pinned environment and uses fresh seeds.
reference_protocol: Compare full statements in both public file modes to pinned SQLite 3.53.4: return code, output, first error diagnostic and persisted catalog/rowids/rows/integrity. Fresh final seed differs from development. No case is filtered or result corrected.
implementation: A separate declared-result detector routes actual bound metadata to the existing collated compound executor. The old explicit-only detector and theorem statements remain unchanged. IN compiles the rightmost SELECT arm result metadata after declaration/lexical binding and single/joined-source expansion through the existing compound-tail metadata compiler; multi-row VALUES retains its first result expression list. Pure compound/JOIN reads delegate before creating a single-source scalar frame; first output affinity comes from actual CTAS column metadata. Scalar SELECT outer comparisons retain their separate non-inheritance behavior.
negative_semantic_control: For a NOCASE v containing a, A IN (SELECT v UNION ALL SELECT NULL) is NULL, whereas reversing the SELECT arms yields 1. VALUES(a COLLATE NOCASE),(NULL) uses its first expression and yields 1; reversing the VALUES rows yields NULL. These are explicit regressions, not a universal rightmost-expression rule.
proof_scope: New structural lemmas prove that the existing independently translated Core read forms contain no declared output metadata, including bindNames preservation. Existing binary and recursively nested compound refinement claims keep their original premises and conclusions. Registered component equations cover ordinary-query routing and IN last-arm selection. These are not a full SQLite compound-equivalence proof.
feature_probe_scope: The 88-case unittest and fresh-seed survey share named families and one generator. Their 14 failures are not a global compatibility percentage.

trusted: Lean elaborator, compiler, runtime and platform C toolchain
IO.FS file operations, fsync, rename and directory locks
Std.Mutex and task scheduling for the serialized connection
the operating system and filesystem page-write behaviour

limitations: Non-BINARY indexes, USING joins and derived/CTE collation materialization remain separate work.
The finite suite does not exhaust nested compound trees, collations, aliases, affinities, NULL/ordering ties or diagnostic priorities.
Views/triggers, WITHOUT ROWID, composite keys, expression/partial indexes, UTF-16 and other SQL/storage limits remain. Generated-cycle versus SELECT preparation priority remains.
The 60 existing SIGKILL samples do not exhaust query-specific crash or concurrent schedules.
